name: Shah Mosque, Mashhad
scope: The standing Timurid Shah Mosque and original tomb mass in Mashhad, also called Masjid-i Imam or Haftad-o Do Tan, with twin minarets, north iwan and bulbous tiled dome.
era: Standing Timurid exterior with documented later repairs.

originalReview.notes: Exact Met object 652129, accession 1977.683.36, 2017 museum scan uploaded with CC0, matched byte for byte. The Met catalog retains public-domain status and qualifies authorship as possibly Luigi Pesce. The photographed mosque is identified by its distinctive arrangement and the published period engraving, which was redundant and excluded from the reference set.

review.notes: Reviewed the Qualla candidate families first and used only the exact CC0 Met museum photograph. The institutional record and 2017 CC0 Commons museum export both identify the accession and link to the same source image. The 1861 engraving depicts the same view and is redundant. Attribution-required photographs, maps and other monuments were excluded.
